the identification of the transcriptional regulatory network controlling the survival of cerebellar granular neurons, a key neuronal subtype in the brain.

the transcriptional program controlling the fate of cerebellar granular neurons in response to apoptosis-inducing and -rescuing signals, and with the identification of transcriptional regulatory elements involved.
